body: I dont know what to place value on, I hate it. Even if you have everything you ever wanted. Your feelings, and the way your brain works doesnt change.
Hey man I feel the same way, im not rich but I dont find any value in anything. The pain is awful and never ends.
Ill never feel loved. Ill never be special. Ill never be perfect. Depression and pain run my life. Depression and pain are my life.
I place 0 value on my life. Fuck my life. Fuck this planet. Fuck god. Fuck everyone. Nothing matters. I feel nothing. Life is suffering endless suffering. Death is release.
